description: DEPRECATED: use planka_board_summary + planka_find_cards. Whole board in one payload: every list, card and label — the most expensive read of the set, and it grows with the board. It returns at most `limit` cards (50 by default) and reports total/truncated when it clips. Archive and trash columns are never included (excludesArchived).

boardId.description: The board ID. Optional when the server has PLANKA_DEFAULT_BOARD_ID.

includeTaskCounts.description: Include task completion counts for each card

limit.description: Max cards across the whole board. Default 50, max 200. Beyond it the response carries truncated: true.

name: planka_get_board
title: Get full board
